# Hugo Tron

> Hugo Tron GmbH is a food importer, wholesaler and distributor in Hamburg, Germany. It sources rice (basmati from India and Pakistan), nuts and dried fruits, spices, saffron, tea and pulses, sells household packs online and supplies businesses in volume, including private label, with delivery throughout Germany and across Europe.

Address: Hugo Tron GmbH, Friesenweg 2b, 22763 Hamburg, Germany
Email: info@hugo-tron.com
Phone: +49 40 210 788 69
